_comment: Snapshot of expected hub test counts. Updated when intentionally adding/removing tests. CI fails if actual drifts beyond tolerance.
captured_from: per-file-isolated `bun run check-baseline` (each hub/test file in its own process — order-independent). P2 (usage-cost-ledger) adds 3 hub test files (usage-pricing, usage-event-handler, usage-cost-api, +14 tests). pass/total here are informational; the enforced gate is pass_min/skip_max/fail_max. fail_max stays 0.

tolerance._comment: Allow modest growth without churn; any fail > 0 always fails CI.
